T: Please look after this bear. And feed him marmalade.
D: A polite young bear from Darkest Peru arrives in London looking for a home.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Paddington takes one out from under his hat.
S: the one he keeps under his hat
Thick white bread buttered right to the edges, spread with a coarse-cut orange marmalade, crusts left on, cut into squares and wrapped in baking paper.
cake and cocoa at the antique shop
Small slices of Dundee cake: butter cake with currants, sultanas, orange zest and ground almonds, topped with almonds in circles, baked at 150C for 2 hours.
Beef mince cooked with onion, cumin, paprika, raisins and olives, wrapped in pastry rounds, crimped, egg washed, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
M: Shepherd's pie: lamb mince browned, onion, carrot, tomato paste and Worcestershire simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash and baked at 200C until golden. Buttered peas.
the jungle in Peru where he grew up
Chicken marinated overnight in garlic, cumin, paprika, lime and a little soy, roasted at 200C, with green sauce of coriander, jalapeño and mayo, and roast potatoes.
W: Buttered bread spread with marmalade, layered in a dish, covered in a custard of eggs, milk and cream, rested 20 minutes, baked at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: Cocoa and sugar whisked into hot milk with a pinch of salt, served in china cups.

s.note: the one he keeps under his hat
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread right to the edges. Spread 4 with coarse-cut Seville orange marmalade and close. Leave the crusts on, cut into squares and wrap each in baking paper. Keep one under your hat for emergencies.

s.note: cake and cocoa at the antique shop
s.how: Beat 150g butter and 150g brown sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 200g flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and orange zest. Spread in a tin, arrange 50g almonds in circles on top and bake at 150C for 2 hours. Cut into small slices.

m.how: Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and bake at 200C until golden. Serve with 300g buttered peas.

w.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with marmalade. Layer in a dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream and 60g sugar and pour over. Rest 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp sugar with a splash of milk into a paste. Add 1L milk and a pinch of salt and heat, whisking, until steaming. Pour into china cups. Have a hard-boiled sweet afterwards.
